page.layout: One printed page, title page with a woodcut vignette in the centre; no columns or margin notes. Stamps (Biblioteca Nazionale Roma oval stamp, handwritten marks, digitiser's watermark) are left out.

main_text.l: Notæ ex præstantissimis huius ævi ICtis,
aliis, collectæ, & inter se collatæ: nec non ad CAII

page.notes: Title page with a woodcut vignette (a figure with animals in an ornamental frame) between the author line and the imprint; the vignette has no text. Printed "CAII" and "VLPIANI" are as printed; the line "nec non ad CAII Institut." is partly obscured by the library stamp, so "CAII" may be read as "CAII" with the stamp over "CAII"/"VLPIANI" endings. Oval library stamp and manuscript annotations ("Ex Legato", "Illustriss. Fortini" area) are excluded.
